Class SimpleProperties

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.simple.props.SimpleProperties
public final class SimpleProperties extends Object
Resolves LogProperties from the following layers, highest priority first:
  1. System properties (LogProperties.StandardProperties.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES).
  2. Environment variables, using "RAINBOWGUM_" (configurable) in place of the "logging." lead segment of the key, remaining .s replaced with _, and casing left exactly as-is; see SimpleProperties.Builder.envPrefix(String).
  3. Profile resources selected by "logging.profiles", first profile wins. These are loaded only when the base resource exists. An empty selection uses the optional default profile; all other profile resources must exist.
  4. A classpath resource (default "classpath:/logging.properties", configurable) parsed the same way LogProperties.Builder.fromProperties(String) parses any other properties text. If the base resource is absent, this module supplies no property sources at all.
Create one with builder(), or just rely on SimplePropertiesProvider picking up the defaults automatically via ServiceLoader. The provider reports selected profiles and classpath resource loading through LogAlerts.

GraalVM native image: this module bundles a resource-config.json (at META-INF/native-image/io.jstach.rainbowgum/rainbowgum-simple-props/) that includes logging.properties and logging-<profile>.properties automatically. Profile names contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens. Custom SimpleProperties.Builder.resource(String) names and their profile variants need corresponding native-image resource metadata.

    • PROFILES_PROPERTY

      public static final String PROFILES_PROPERTY
      Comma-separated profiles, in priority order. Resolved from system properties, environment variables, or SimpleProperties.Builder.profiles(List), in that priority order, after the base classpath resource is found. With the default environment prefix, use RAINBOWGUM_profiles. For example, logging.profiles=local-dev,dev loads logging-local-dev.properties before logging-dev.properties, with logging.properties as fallback. A missing base resource disables all property sources from this module, regardless of profile selection. With no profiles selected, the optional default profile is used. It is not included automatically when other profiles are selected. A missing selected profile resource fails initialization unless its name is default. Files cannot activate additional profiles.
      See Also:
